caption: The drawing depicts a doorway with a partially open arched wooden door, revealing a shadowed interior space. The arch above the door is decorated with a geometric star or flower design in blue and red, flanked by a zigzag pattern in red and outlined with blue. The frame of the doorway and the surrounding wall are painted in warm earthy tones, with the wall being a soft tan or light orange. Vertical evergreen-like leaf patterns in green rise on either side of the doorway. There is a decorative horizontal band below the arch, consisting of circular and intertwining motifs in blue, green, and red. The bottom of the wall is bordered by a blue line that wraps around the structure. The floor in front of the door is rendered in shades of brown and red, resembling terracotta tiles, and a small section of the wall in the lower right corner appears chipped, exposing brickwork underneath. The artist's signature and the date "1935" are present in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Wall Painting
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
